title.narrative: Building Government Capacity for Better Monitoring for Results

description.narrative: " The objective of the grant is creating institutional knowledge and capacity at the Government of Armenia to reform business processes within the central government and establish a government wide results monitoring framework. Comprehensive governance review assessing Armenian public administration systemcomma inter aliacomma focusing on (i) business processes survey at the Government Staff and up to 17 line ministriescomma and (ii) monitoring and evaluation (M&E) framework and the set of performance indicators for business processes and progress towards policy objectives (in cooperation with National Statistical Service). The key processescomma the management processes and the support processes have to be defined: (i) the existing processes will be defined and analyzedcomma (ii) their relevance will be evaluated in the light of the missioncomma strategic and operational objectives of the Government as well as the urge of efficiency and of the e-government programcomma (iii) processes will be redesigned where necessary and digitization prospects will be observed. In case of some business processescomma in particular for policy formulation and results monitoringcomma it will be ""engineering"" rather than reengineeringcomma since there are no adequate processes defined. One of the policy options notes presented by the Bank to the incoming Government of Armenia specifically focused on policy formulation and analyses. The planned review will be a good opportunity to introduce clear and efficient procedures instead of current ad-hoc operationcomma since reengineering makes a more systematiccomma methodical way of working possible. In context of the plans of applying the model of public private partnershipscomma the study may also follow-up on one of the common BPR questions - if particular service should be providedcomma whether it is the public sectorcomma the private sectorcomma or partnerships that can do it most effectively. The Government Staff is planning to establish a specialized unit that will be responsible for monitoring and evaluation of particular ministries. Based on the produced manuals for the new business processes and encapsulated M&E framework the team leader and the international consultant (from the team which conducted the BPR) will deliver a 5 day training to the staff or this unit as well as to the public servants who will be related with M&E procedures at the line ministries. The team leader will deliver a follow-on training/workshop after initial month/s of introducing the system. TF093847 The development objective of the grant is creating institutional knowledge and capacity within the Government of Armenia to reform business processes within the central government by developing the basis for a national M&E system."
